stories.scene: Vetvel, a shaggy tan-furred horned Jomkar with octagonal goggle eyes, stands on the porch of a widow's adobe dome house, her hand on the half-open outer door. In the dim inner doorway a figure heading out stands frozen face to face with her, seen only as a dark backlit silhouette; both pause in an awkward standoff over who yields. Warm afternoon light on the porch, cool shadow inside.
stories.place: porch of a widow's adobe dome house

stories.scene: Skordokott, a tall Tayran with a white skeletal beak-skull and a single red eye, stands inside his dome home visibly exhausted, shoulders sagging, eye heavy and dull. Vetvel faces him, studying him with concern and hesitating to speak. Dim lamplight, quiet weary mood.

On a sandy footpath outside a dome house, Vetvel straightens up from a crouch holding a small stick, a tiny iridescent green beetle wandering on her foot. Behind her in the doorway a figure emerging from the house is seen only as a dark silhouette, glaring with suspicion. Bright midday sun, comic embarrassed mood.

Inside a dim perishables warehouse lined with stacked wooden crates, Vetvel scrambles up from a heap of broken crate and spilled vegetables. A figure striding toward her down the narrow aisle is seen from behind, in shadow, while another person flees out of sight at the far end. Dusty shafts of light through high slits, tense comic mood.

In a quiet recessed corner of the colony cafeteria, Vetvel stops short holding a tray with buttered vegetables and a roll, eyes wide in an awkward moment. The occupant of the corner table is off-frame, suggested only by a shadow and a plate at the edge of the picture. Plain adobe walls, soft overhead light, sticky social tension.

Zubi, a bald blue-skinned Srol with a smooth dome head, sits on the sand between two large barrels with her head buried in her hands. Vetvel approaches carefully from the open path, leaning in with concern. Late afternoon light, long shadows, melancholy mood.

Behind the cafeteria, Skordokott, a powerfully built but aging Tayran with a white beak-skull, strains to shove a heavy wooden box up a ramp, panting. Excited children cluster around him: two small Klasts, a little Tayran and a young Frem, cheering. Vetvel watches in surprise from the corner; bright sunny afternoon, warm playful mood.

Zubi, a bald blue-domed Srol, stands waiting just outside a dome house door with arms folded and a sarcastic knowing smile as Vetvel steps out. Bright daylight on the adobe wall, Lamina, the blue cloud-swirled planet, in the sky; mood of mocking confrontation.

On a dusty colony path, an ancient hunched old woman with a cane stops directly in front of Vetvel, her huge black swirling eyes fixed on her. Vetvel stands rigid, uneasy, caught between dread and fascination. Pale harsh daylight, still and eerie mood, adobe domes in the background.

Vetvel stands alone on a high sand hill among rolling dunes, wind ruffling her shaggy fur, looking toward two distant motionless figures standing on separate hilltops, too far away to recognize. A far mountain range on the northern horizon and the blue living planet Lamina low in the sky. Bright, vast, eerie silence.

Inside a dome house, Vetvel stares with startled, wide goggle eyes and a suppressed grin at a companion who has turned away from her; the companion is seen only from behind, the back hem of their tunic comically snagged and bunched up on their belt (nothing revealed). Warm interior lamplight, awkward comedic moment.

Behind Gardbore's adobe dome house, Vetvel stands on a wooden box, pressing one goggle eye to a thin crack in the wall. Through the crack we glimpse Gardbore, a large shaggy Frem, alone in the center of a draped room, waving his arms as if conducting music. Golden afternoon light outside, curious secretive mood.

Vetvel sits flat on her bottom in a small cloud of dust, arm raised holding a ball, while a young Frem and a young Srol roll on the ground laughing. Wiki, a sleek black cat-like Ripi, stands in a nearby doorway staring at the spectacle. Bright sunny street, slapstick mood.

In Kendra's colorful home, an elderly, stern Klast woman scolds Kendra fiercely, finger raised, while Kendra looks embarrassed and tries to placate her. Vetvel stands to one side, ignored and uncomfortable. Warm lamplight, tense family-quarrel mood.

Vetvel crouches beneath the window of a lone human's house, peeking over the sill at a wild-haired, bearded human man pacing his room beside an old computer, muttering. He has just turned toward the window and she cringes to hide. Sunlit adobe wall outside, dim cluttered room inside, comic mood.

Inside a dome house, a flustered, bearded human man with wild hair barges through the door, gesturing urgently. Vetvel stares at him incredulously; the host who opened the door stands in the foreground seen from behind. Warm interior light, absurd comedic mood.

Inside a dome house, an agitated bearded human man stands in the doorway glaring and lecturing with theatrical gestures. Vetvel looks down at the floor sheepishly; her companion beside her, seen from behind, scrapes the floor with a foot. Comic scolding mood, warm lamplight.

A bearded human man presses his face flat against a window pane from outside, nose squashed and lips flattened, peering in. Inside, Vetvel and a companion seen from behind turn toward the window in disgusted surprise. Bright daylight outside, dim room inside, absurd comedic mood.
stories.place: inside a dome house, by the window

stories.scene: On a colony path, an eager young Jomkar boy with shaggy fur and small horn nubs hurries up to Vetvel, eyes glowing with admiration. Vetvel halts with a resigned look, caught. Bright morning light, adobe domes and Lamina in the sky.

In a narrow alley between two adobe cottages, Vetvel tries to slip away but the eager young Jomkar boy pops out at the far end to intercept her, beaming. Vetvel's posture shows reluctant exasperation. Midday sun, comic chase mood.

On a sunny colony path, Vetvel walks with confident posture while an excited young Jomkar boy bounds toward her, gesturing enthusiastically and full of questions. Bright cheerful light, Lamina large in the sky.
On a dusty colony path on a gloomy day, a downcast Vetvel is approached by an eager young Jomkar boy rushing up with an indignant, loyal expression. Overcast muted light, dejected mood.

Inside a dome house, Vetvel stares at a bright window where the dark silhouette of a small young Jomkar boy is pressed, eavesdropping. Her companion in the foreground, seen from behind, has turned to look at the window too. Glaring daylight outside, tense awkward mood.

Vetvel leans against an adobe wall, gazing up in wonder at three white clouds arranged as the corners of a perfect equilateral triangle in the clear desert sky. She is alone; the blue living planet Lamina hangs nearby. Calm, uncanny mood, bright daylight.

On a walkway cluttered with household furniture set outside a dome house, Vetvel stands transfixed before a triple mirror stand that shows three reflections of her. Two figures in the background carry a heavy chest away. Bright daylight, contemplative dreamlike mood.
In Kendra's home, Vetvel leans toward Kendra with a pleading, earnest look, while Kendra turns her head away, evasive and uncomfortable. Warm low lamplight, intimate strained mood.

Inside Gardbore's dome home, Vetvel leans back in her chair, exasperated, while Gardbore, a large elderly Frem, speaks calmly with a raised hand, giving measured advice. Soft lamplight, quiet frustrated mood.
In Wiki's home, Wiki, a sleek black cat-like Ripi, answers quickly with a confident gesture while Vetvel stares at him in disbelief. Warm interior light, mood of naive advice met with skepticism.
In Zubi's home, Vetvel leans forward to speak quietly, while Zubi, a bald blue-domed Srol, draws back, taken aback and shaking her head in firm refusal. Soft interior light, tense serious mood.
On a colony path, a sturdy male Jomkar with shaggy fur and horns hurries toward Vetvel, waving and calling out with relief at finding her. Bright afternoon light, warm but concerned mood.

On a colony path, an old, worn Frem woman in field clothes catches up with Vetvel and pauses to catch her breath, a sly sarcastic smile on her face. Vetvel waits, visibly irritated. Hot afternoon light, mood of veiled threat.

A lively young Ripi woman with sleek black fur and a glowing nose pulls Vetvel aside to the edge of a colony path, wrinkling her nose and speaking earnestly. Bright friendly daylight, gentle but pointed mood.

A sour-faced male Srol with a bald blue dome head confronts Vetvel on a colony path, giving the thinnest of greetings with a foul expression. Vetvel looks wary and annoyed. Harsh midday light, unpleasant mood.

A crimson horse-like Lokweel woman with big floppy ears and a curly purple mane strolls up to Vetvel, talking animatedly; behind them stands a radio mast and a large aimable sun mirror on the communications station. Bright daylight, Lamina in the sky, conversational mood.
On a colony path, a blunt, sturdy male Jomkar with horns bumps into Vetvel and immediately speaks with a stern, frank expression. Vetvel stops, startled. Plain daylight, awkward serious mood.

In a cluttered mechanical repair shop, a tired male Klast technician leans on a workbench strewn with worn parts, gesturing toward an old battered tractor at the end of the shop. Vetvel stands listening in the doorway. Dusty light through the open door, weary resigned mood.

In a dark narrow cranny between two adobe houses, a crouching bearded human man peers around furtively and beckons to Vetvel, who approaches warily from the sunlit path. Strong contrast of shadow and bright light, comic conspiratorial mood.

On a colony path, Vetvel turns around sharply to face a grinning bearded human man who is fading away into thin air, his body already transparent so that only his eyebrows and grinning teeth remain clearly visible. Bright daylight, surreal comic mood.

Outside a dome house, a bearded human man in a flamboyant pinstriped zoot suit swings a pocket watch on a chain and does a soft-shoe dance toward a small shed. Vetvel stands dumbfounded. Bright afternoon light, absurd vaudeville mood.
A bearded human man laughs heartily, pointing at Vetvel as she walks out on a colony path the morning after a defeat. Vetvel looks tired and unamused. Morning light, mocking comic mood.

On a hot colony street, Vetvel ducks as a bearded human man flies low over her head with arms spread like wings, grinning wildly, then climbs into the sky trailing a white looping contrail (no legible letters). Blazing sun, Lamina in the sky, absurd surreal mood.
stories.place: square in front of a house

stories.scene: In a small square in front of a dome house, a huge old-fashioned armored tank has rolled up and stopped before Vetvel, who stands frozen with knees knocking. Its long barrel is angled off to the side, and a cartoonish hand pokes out of the muzzle holding out a small folded note. Churned ground, bright daylight, absurd surreal mood.
stories.place: square in front of a house

stories.scene: In Skordokott's home, Skordokott, a tall Tayran with a white beak-skull and a red eye, stands at the window with his back half-turned, staring out, his posture rigid with hurt. Vetvel sits behind him, about to speak. Cold pale light through the window, somber heartbroken mood.

In a quiet secluded spot away from the walkway, a young Jomkar boy with a huge proud grin leans in close to whisper to Vetvel, glancing around to be sure no one hears. Vetvel steps back, aghast. Shadowy nook, warm side light, conspiratorial tense mood.
